name: Orbital Planner
description: Plan impulsive burns to rendezvous with a moving satellite or moon in 2D Earth orbit.

binding_vow.description: The agent receives a spacecraft state, a moving target on a Keplerian orbit (satellite or massive moon), fuel budget, and time limit. It submits a JSON mission plan with impulsive burns. Physics uses RK4 gravity integration (Earth + optional moon third-body). Score rewards close approach and fuel efficiency.

observation_space.description: { scenario_id, name, tier, spacecraft: {position, velocity}, target: {kind, position, velocity, tolerance_km, orbit...}, fuel_budget_dv, time_limit_s, steps_remaining, instruction }

action_space.description: JSON string: {"burns":[...], "reasoning": "Mesocosm multi-line agent trace", "commit": true}

reward.description: Final mission score / 100 (0–1). Parse errors give small negative step rewards; truncated episodes score 0.
